stem_book: An ideal diatomic gas is caused to pass through a cycle shown on the P-V diagram in figure, where V₂ = 3.00 V₁. If P₁, V₁ and T₁ specify the state 1, then the temperature of the state 3 is (a) (T₁/3)¹ (b) (T₁/3)⁴ (c) T₁(1/3)^(0.4) (d) (T₁/3)²
work: 1→3 adiabatic, V₃ = V₂ = 3V₁, γ = 1.4: T₃ = T₁(V₁/V₃)^(γ−1) = T₁(1/3)^(0.4)
